description: Listings reposted at a lower price over the last 30 days, with the previous price and the drop in %, largest first. Same filters as search_condos: budget, bedrooms, station, line, district. Returns bkkradar.com links.

furnished.description: full, partial or none: as the post says it. Posts that do not say are left out.

lang.description: Language of the titles and links: en, fr, th, ja (Japanese), zh (simplified Chinese) or ru (Russian). Use the user's language.

limit.description: Listings to return, 20 by default, 50 at most.

line.description: Line code or name ("BTS-SUK", "BTS Sukhumvit", "MRT Blue"), or a whole network: "BTS", "MRT".

max_price.description: Maximum price in THB (per month for rent).

max_walk_minutes.description: Walk to the listing's nearest BTS/MRT station, at most, in minutes (straight line at 80 m a minute). With a station or line and no value: 12 (1 km).

min_size_sqm.description: Living area, at least, in m².

owner_only.description: true: only the listings posted by their owner, not by an agent.

pets_allowed.description: true: only the listings whose post says pets are allowed. Most posts do not say, and those are left out.

property_kind.description: Kind of property; any for all.

sort.description: drop (largest drop in % first) or price (cheapest first).

station.description: BTS/MRT station name or code, e.g. "Asok", "Phrom Phong", "BTS-CEN".

name: price_drops
title: Recent price drops
